settings.title: AI sales agent
settings.intro: Your best salesperson, on WhatsApp all day: it answers every enquiry in seconds, understands the trip, recommends your packages with prices, handles objections, takes booking details and follows up at the right time. It flags your team when a lead is ready, learns from your chats every night, and scores every lead.
settings.problem: Check the values: the daily limit is 1 to 200 and the follow-up hours 1 to 23.

model.offTitle: The AI is not set up on this server yet
model.offDescription: Ask the platform to set AI_API_KEY (and AI_BASE_URL and AI_CHAT_MODELS for the chosen provider). Until then nothing here runs. You can still add what the AI should know.

test.title: Try it
test.description: Ask what a customer might, and see what the AI would answer from what it knows and has learned. Nothing is sent.
test.question: A customer's question
test.placeholder: Kerala ka 5 din ka package kitne ka hai?
test.handoff: It would hand the chat to your team: {reason}

knowledge.title: What the AI knows
knowledge.description: Your packages, prices, inclusions, dates, payment details (UPI ID, bank account, advance) and policies. The AI quotes only from these, and tells your team when something isn't here.
knowledge.upload: Upload a PDF or text file
knowledge.uploaded: Uploaded. The AI is reading it.
knowledge.fileType: Choose a PDF or a .txt file.
knowledge.empty: Nothing yet. Add your packages and prices so the AI can answer about them.
knowledge.alsoKnown: Your trips' details and your quote packages are known too, without adding them here.
knowledge.removeDescription: The AI won't know it any more.
knowledge.dialogDescription: Write it as you would tell a new salesperson: the package, what's included, the price and its basis.
knowledge.bodyPlaceholder: Kerala 5N/6D: Munnar 2N, Thekkady 1N, Alleppey houseboat 1N, Kovalam 1N. ₹18,500 per person on twin sharing, hotels, breakfast, cab and sightseeing included. Flights extra.

chat.title: AI assistant
chat.info: The AI sells to this customer by itself inside WhatsApp's 24-hour window, from what your agency taught it and learned, and alerts you when the lead is ready. Take over any time.
chat.notConfigured: The AI is not set up on this server yet.
chat.answering: The AI is answering this chat.
chat.notAnswering: The AI isn't answering this chat.
chat.handedOff: The AI handed this chat to your team.
chat.barAnswering: {name} is answering this chat. If you write, it steps back for 30 minutes.
chat.barOff: You are answering this chat. The AI is off here.
chat.barFlagged: {name} flagged: {reason}. It's still answering; join any time.
chat.voiceLabel: Talk like a person in this chat
chat.personaLabel: What the AI is for in this chat
chat.salesHint: It sells here: trips, prices and bookings.
chat.naturalHint: It chats here like a normal person, as the voice below, and remembers what you two talked about.

insight.title: AI insight
insight.info: The AI's view of this lead from its chat: how likely it books in the next two weeks, why, and what to do next. A guess to help you choose who to call first, never a decision.
insight.none: No insight yet: it comes after the customer's next message.
insight.fakeHint: Spam, a test or a wrong number, by the AI's reading.

suggest.label: Suggest a reply with AI
suggest.nothing: The AI had nothing to suggest.

hero.liveLine: {name} is answering every WhatsApp chat by itself, day and night.
hero.pausedLine: It answers only in the chats where you turn it on. Turn on Answer every chat to let it sell all day.
hero.notSetUpLine: Once the platform sets up a model, it can start selling.

chats.label: Chats answered
chats.hint: Chats the AI wrote in over the last 24 hours.

speed.label: Reply time

hot.label: Hot leads
hot.hint: Leads the AI judged likely to book soon, this week, fakes left out.

flagged.label: Flagged for you
flagged.hint: Chats where the AI asked your team to look or join, over the last 24 hours.

followUps.label: Follow-ups planned
followUps.hint: Quiet customers the AI will write to again, at the time it chose, inside WhatsApp's 24-hour window.

learnings.label: Lessons learned
learnings.hint: What the AI learned from your chats and uses in every reply.

personality.title: Personality
personality.description: How your AI agent speaks to customers. It always answers from your knowledge and never makes up a price.
personality.name: Its name
personality.nameHint: The name it introduces itself with. Leave empty to speak as your agency.

styleHints.human: Natural WhatsApp messages of a few short lines, as a real salesperson types.
styleHints.short: One or two lines at a time, for customers who want it quick.
styleHints.points: A short opener, then the details as bullet points: easy to scan.

personality.instructionsPlaceholder: Always ask for the travel dates and the number of people early. Mention our free airport pickup.
personality.instructionsHint: Anything it should always do or never say. Prices and packages go in Knowledge.

suggestion.dates: Ask for the travel dates and the number of travellers early.
suggestion.pickup: Mention our free airport pickup with every package.
suggestion.twoOptions: Offer a 3-star and a 4-star option side by side.
suggestion.honeymoon: For honeymoon couples, suggest the candle-light dinner add-on.
suggestion.advance: To book, ask for a 30% advance by UPI.
suggestion.noDiscount: Never promise a discount; say the team will check.
suggestion.budget: If the budget is low, suggest fewer nights rather than a cheaper hotel.
suggestion.itinerary: Share the full itinerary once they give their dates.

sales.label: Sales agent
sales.description: It sells: understands the trip, recommends your packages, handles objections and takes the booking's details.

natural.label: Natural conversation
natural.description: It chats like a normal person about whatever the other side brings up, as the person whose chat you uploaded below, and helps with trips only when asked.

selling.title: How it sells
selling.description: It writes only inside WhatsApp's 24-hour window, never to someone who asked to stop, and steps back for 30 minutes whenever someone on your team writes in a chat.
selling.autopilotHint: On: the AI takes every chat, unless you turn it off in one. Off: it answers only the chats you turn it on in.
selling.handoff: When does it hand a chat to your team?

alert.label: Never by itself (recommended)
alert.description: It sells right through to the booking: takes the details, shares how to pay from your knowledge, and alerts the lead's owner when a lead is ready. It stops only when someone presses Take over.

asked.label: When the customer asks for a person
asked.description: It handles everything else and alerts your team, but steps back when a customer asks for a person or is upset.

careful.label: For bookings, payments and discounts too
careful.description: It steps back as soon as a customer wants to book or pay, asks for a discount, or asks something your knowledge doesn't answer.

selling.followUpsHint: One message to a customer who goes quiet, while WhatsApp's 24-hour window is open, so no lead goes cold.
selling.smartFollowUpHint: It decides for each customer whether to write again and when: soon for a hot lead, later for someone asking their family, never after a no.
selling.scoringHint: After each message: its chance to book, why, the next step, and whether it looks fake.
selling.learningHint: Each night it reads your recent chats, the booked and the lost, and learns what your customers want and what wins them.
selling.maxReplies: Most AI messages in a chat per day
selling.maxRepliesHint: A safety limit, so a chat can't run away.

learnings.title: What the AI learned
learnings.description: Lessons from your own chats, used in every reply. Turn off one you disagree with, or remove it.
learnings.empty: Nothing learned yet. After a few days of chats, the AI writes down what your customers want and what wins them.
learnings.evidence: {count, plural, one {seen in # chat} other {seen in # chats}}

voice.title: Talk like a real person
voice.description: Give the AI a WhatsApp chat and choose whose way of talking to copy: it reads the whole chat, both sides, and writes exactly as that person does: their words, Hinglish, emojis, warmth and feelings. Here it is for every chat; in one chat's AI panel it also remembers what the two talked about. Asked sincerely whether it is an AI, it never denies it.
voice.how: In WhatsApp, open the chat, tap ⋮ → More → Export chat → Without media, and upload the .txt here. The chat's latest messages go to the AI with numbers and emails taken out; the chat itself isn't kept, only how the person talks and, in a chat, what the two talked about.
voice.notAnExport: This file doesn't look like a WhatsApp chat export. Export it from WhatsApp, without media.
voice.dialogDescription: {count, plural, one {# message read.} other {# messages read.}} Choose the person the AI should talk like.
voice.tooFew: Too few messages to learn from
voice.inherited: Talking like {name}, as in every chat
voice.examples: {count, plural, one {Learned from their messages; keeps # of them as examples.} other {Learned from their messages; keeps # of them as examples.}}
